newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Good movement this week but packers now pulling back on bids.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.150 cent. Index up further and corn seen lower but markets may be topping.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.200 to up 0.100 cent. Nearbys down with cash markets, backs firm from report.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to off 0.250 cent. Old crop up on out-of-town and new crop seen down on profit taking.0
